name: Fabricator's Bracers

effects.name: Cannith Combat Infusion
effects.tooltip: Cannith Combat Infusion : Your ranged and melee attacks have a chance to cause this item to inject a Cannith Combat Infusion into your bloodstream. For the next ten seconds, this will grant a +4 Alchemical bonus to Strength, Constitution and Dexterity, as well as a 5% Alchemical bonus to your chance to doublestrike and a +2 Alchemical bonus to Armor Class .

effects.name: Incite
effects.tooltip: Incite +20 : +20% Enhancement bonus to increased threat generation from melee damage

effects.name: Balance
effects.tooltip: Balance +10 : Passive: +10 Competence bonus to the Balance skill.

effects.name: Enhanced Balance
effects.tooltip: Enhanced Balance +5 : Passive: +5 Enhancement bonus to the Balance skill.

effects.name: Nearly Finished - Fabricator's Ingenuity
effects.tooltip: Fabricator's Ingenuity : +25% stacking fortification and +2 artifact bonus to your attack and damage rolls.

flavor_text: Fabricators of House Cannith wear sturdy bracers like these to protect them from the dangerous machinery they work with.

source.raw: Blown to Bits , Iron Fire Bomber 's chest
